verdict.rationale: The trademark apply page states the filing wall up front: you need a USPTO.gov account with multifactor authentication and identity verification before you can log in to TEAS and Trademark Center. It also says the one-time verification takes under 15 minutes online, offers a paper alternative, and lets you preview forms without logging in. missing for 10: specifics of which MFA methods and identity documents are required, an equivalent up-front statement of the account and proofing steps for Patent Center filing, and independent or hands-on corroboration that no extra steps surface mid-flow.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes exactly which account, credential, and identity-proofing steps stand between me and filing — stated before I start, not discovered mid-flow

citations.quote: create a USPTO.gov account with multifactor authentication methods and verify your identity before you can log in to access TEAS and Trademark Center.
this one-time verification process can be completed online in less than 15 minutes. We also offer a paper verification process for those who do not wish to verify online.
You can preview TEAS forms without logging in on our form previews page.
